question: If Luffy, Kid, and Law played a game of rock-paper-scissors, who would win? Would it be Luffy because he can see the future? (6-Year-Old Senior)
answer: Okay! This is a great question! It's true that Luffy can see the future and could do that to win! But Luffy hates cheating, so I don't think he'd look into the future. The three of them don't get along very well with each other, I think they'd end up fighting no matter who wins!
